name: mofa-pdf
description: PDF manipulation toolkit: extract text/tables, create PDFs, merge/split, fill forms, convert PDF to Word/Markdown

discovery.summary: Comprehensive PDF document processing — text/table extraction, PDF creation, merge/split, form filling, and PDF-to-Word conversion via Python scripts.

hints.when: extracting text or tables from PDF, creating PDFs, merging/splitting, or general PDF processing
filling PDF forms or inspecting form fields
converting PDF to Word (.docx) or Word to Markdown
looking up advanced PDF features or JavaScript PDF libraries

tools.name: pdf_extract_text
tools.description: Extract text content from a PDF file using pdfplumber. Returns the full text of all pages. Use this for reading PDF documents, searching content, or preparing text for further processing.

pdf_path.description: Path to the PDF file to extract text from

pages.description: Page range to extract (e.g. '1-5', '1,3,5'). Defaults to all pages.

tools.name: pdf_extract_tables
tools.description: Extract tables from a PDF file using pdfplumber and export to Excel/CSV. Use this when the user needs tabular data from invoices, reports, or any structured PDF.

pdf_path.description: Path to the PDF file containing tables

pages.description: Page range to extract tables from (e.g. '1-5'). Defaults to all pages.

tools.name: pdf_convert_to_word
tools.description: Convert a PDF file to Word (.docx) format. Uses pdf2docx for layout-preserving conversion. For scanned PDFs, OCR pre-processing is required first.

pdf_path.description: Path to the input PDF file

output_path.description: Path to save the output .docx file
